newsitem.title: CROATIA: Bank Austria loans Croatia Podravka 20 mln marks.
newsitem.headline: Bank Austria loans Croatia Podravka 20 mln marks.

text.p: Croatia's leading food concern Podravka will get a 20 million German mark ($11.6 million) loan from Bank Austria for financial restructuring, company officials said on Thursday.
The five-year loan, including a one-year grace period, will be paid off at 4.2 percent and is guaranteed by the government, Podravka's financial manager Dragica Salamon told Reuters.
"It will be used for financial restructuring, to pay off our current, more expensive loans granted by local banks and thus, reduce our overall costs," she said.
Vienna-based Bank Austria provided most of the credit while 5 million marks came from the bank's Croatian subsidiary, which opened here in April.
Podravka is among the most actively traded stocks on the Zagreb Bourse.

Its still unpublished 1996 annual results are rumoured to be negative, though it shed its loss-making non-core subsidiaries in an effort to become more profitable. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385 1 4557075 ($ = 1.725 German Marks)
